# Editor conveniences (#251)

Open this note in the editor (E) and try each gesture. Ctrl+Z undoes every
one of them in a single step.

## Move lines

- Alt+Up / Alt+Down moves the caret line, or every line of a selection.
- A selection that ends at the start of a line leaves that line in place.

1. First step
2. Second step
3. Third step

## Wrap a selection

Select *this phrase* and type one of " ' ` * ~ ^ = : ( [ { — it wraps the
selection and keeps it selected, so typing * twice makes it **bold**.

> Quote with a word to wrap: emphasis.

## Several carets

Put a caret after `Name`, press Ctrl+Alt+Down twice, then type spaces until
the pipes line up. Alt+Click adds or removes single carets, Ctrl+D selects
the word and then its next occurrence, Esc returns to one caret.

| Name | Role |
